news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 11% year-over-year to $8.1 million, beating prior guidance, with recurring revenue up 14% and consumables hitting quarterly unit/revenue records; gross margin reached a record 15% and the company placed its 200th Growth Direct system while reaffirming full-year 2026 guidance of $37-41 million.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 90,000 restricted stock units and a non-qualified option to purchase 170,000 shares to a new employee as a material inducement to employment, continuing routine hiring-related equity grants under Nasdaq rules.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: The company confirmed it would report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 7, 2026, with a management webcast conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems CEO exercises stock options, boosts holdings
news.summary: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercised a fully-vested stock option for 1,402 Class A shares at $0.75 on July 22, 2026, bringing his direct holdings to roughly 1.19 million shares.

catalysts.label: European Growth Direct Day (Darmstadt, Germany)
catalysts.detail: Third of three planned 2026 regional customer events, hosted by Merck MilliporeSigma at its innovation center, following the North America event Amgen sponsored in Q2 2026; used to showcase Growth Direct platform adoption to prospective biopharma customers.

catalysts.label: 10 millionth Growth Direct consumable shipped
catalysts.detail: Company stated on the Q2 earnings call it expects to ship its 10 millionth consumable in Q3 2026, a symbolic adoption/usage milestone highlighted to investors.

catalysts.label: Additional $10M Trinity Capital debt tranche
catalysts.detail: Management said on the Q2 call it believes it is on track to meet the operating milestones required to draw a further $10 million tranche under its Trinity Capital debt facility later in 2026, with a subsequent $10 million tranche potentially available in mid-2027.

catalysts.label: 30-38 Growth Direct system placements / at least 27 validations
catalysts.detail: Reaffirmed FY2026 guidance calls for $37-41 million revenue on 30-38 new system placements and at least 27 completed system validations (raised from 25), key operational metrics investors will track quarterly.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly financial results release; exact date not yet announced as of this research.

pulse: Rapid Micro Biosystems posted a solid Q2 2026 print (August 7) with 11% revenue growth, a record 15% gross margin, and its 200th Growth Direct system placement, while reaffirming full-year guidance of $37-41 million on 30-38 placements. The company remains pre-profitability (Q2 net loss widened to $12.9 million) and is running a cost-efficiency program targeting positive cash flow by end of 2028, with near-term catalysts centered on system validations, an October European customer event, and continued access to Trinity Capital debt tranches rather than any major new commercial deal in the last 45 days.
